---
name: Bug report
about: Something is broken or behaving incorrectly
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**What happened?** A clear description of the incorrect behavior.

**Where?** Page or route (e.g. `/product/netflix`, admin orders), and whether
on https://subnation.ly or a local setup.

**Steps to reproduce** (if not obvious):

**What did you expect?**

**Environment** (if relevant): browser, device, Arabic/English UI.

**Evidence** (strongly encouraged): console errors, network response,
screenshot. We fix from evidence — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
